chunks.head: put an end to
chunks.note: put an end to sth = 使某事停止、终结。
chunks.ex_en: The new rule put an end to loud parties at night.
chunks.ex_cn: 新规定终止了夜里的喧闹聚会。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over (doing sth) = 放弃、罢手；此处指放弃计划。
chunks.ex_en: Don't give over so easily; keep trying.
chunks.ex_cn: 别这么轻易放弃,继续试。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上、上了岸(与在海上/船上相对)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors went on shore to buy fresh food.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们上岸去买新鲜食物。

chunks.head: a good deal of
chunks.note: a good deal of + 不可数名词 = 相当多的。
chunks.ex_en: She spent a good deal of time on that puzzle.
chunks.ex_cn: 她在那道谜题上花了很多时间。

chunks.head: every now and then
chunks.note: 固定搭配,表'不时地、偶尔'。
chunks.ex_en: Every now and then we visit our grandparents.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们时不时去看望祖父母。

chunks.head: lay aside
chunks.note: lay aside = 把(想法、担忧等)放到一边、暂搁。
chunks.ex_en: Please lay aside your worries and get some rest.
chunks.ex_cn: 把担忧放到一边,好好休息吧。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: lay up = 储备、收存起来(此处指把船停放收好待用)。
chunks.ex_en: Farmers lay up food for the long winter.
chunks.ex_cn: 农民储备食物过漫长的冬天。

chunks.head: at length
chunks.note: at length = 经过一段时间后,终于。
chunks.ex_en: At length the rain stopped and the sun came out.
chunks.ex_cn: 最终雨停了,太阳出来了。

chunks.head: to be sure
chunks.note: 插入语,表'确实、诚然'(常引出让步)。
chunks.ex_en: The test was hard, to be sure, but I still passed.
chunks.ex_cn: 这考试确实难,不过我还是过了。

chunks.head: lose sight of
chunks.note: lose sight of sth = 看不见、跟丢(也可喻指忽略)。
chunks.ex_en: Don't lose sight of the child in the crowd.
chunks.ex_cn: 别在人群里跟丢了孩子。

chunks.head: break out
chunks.note: break out = (从围栏、监狱等)挣脱冲出;也指(战争等)爆发。此处为前义。
chunks.ex_en: The prisoners tried to break out of the jail.

chunks.head: stop short
chunks.note: stop short = 猛地停下、戛然而止。
chunks.ex_en: The dog stopped short when it heard the whistle.
chunks.ex_cn: 狗一听到哨声就猛地停住了。
